scenario_tech_surge.name: Scenario A: Tech Outperformance & Generative AI Contract Boom
scenario_tech_surge.description: Infosys secures a $1.5B global enterprise contract and TCS beats Q3 estimates with $9.2B total deal wins, triggering a bullish shift towards IT services.

items.title: Infosys Secures Landmark $1.5 Billion Generative AI Expansion Contract with Global Tier-1 Bank
items.text: Infosys today announced an expanded strategic collaboration valued at over $1.5 billion over five years to provide generative AI-driven engineering and enterprise cloud modernization for a leading European financial institution. The agreement is expected to significantly boost operating margins and market share.
items.author: Economic Times Bureau

items.title: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Reports 8.4% YoY Q3 Profit Growth, Beats Street Estimates
items.text: TCS delivered strong third-quarter results, driven by strong deal bookings worth $9.2 billion. Management highlighted accelerating discretionary IT spending and resilience in North American banking client accounts, declaring an interim dividend of Rs 28 per share.
items.author: Mint Markets

items.title: Huge institutional accumulation in Indian IT giants $INFY and $TCS
items.text: Massive call buying in $INFY and $TCS today. Tech index poised for a strong multi-month breakout as AI deal momentum offsets US macro worries. Upweighting tech! #NiftyIT #DalalStreet
items.author: @QuantDesk_BOM (Twitter/X)

scenario_banking_stress.name: Scenario B: Banking Sector Regulatory Action & Asset Quality Headwinds
scenario_banking_stress.description: RBI imposes digital compliance penalties and warnings on major lenders, causing risk-off rebalancing away from banking into defensive assets.

items.title: RBI Imposes Rs 2.5 Crore Penalty on HDFC Bank Over Digital Compliance Lapses
items.text: The Reserve Bank of India has issued an administrative penalty of Rs 2.5 crore on HDFC Bank for non-compliance with certain regulatory directions regarding digital banking infrastructure resiliency and reporting standards. Analysts note this may raise short-term compliance costs and draw regulatory scrutiny.
items.author: Reuters Finance

items.title: Concerns over HDFC Bank net interest margins and digital audit findings
items.text: RBI fine on $HDFCBANK raises questions about legacy IT integration after merger. Margin recovery delayed. Banking index looking heavy today. #NiftyBank #HDFC
items.author: @FinWizard_IN (Twitter/X)

items.title: State Bank of India (SBIN) Approves Raising Rs 10,000 Crore via Infrastructure Bonds
items.text: The executive committee of the State Bank of India central board has approved raising up to Rs 10,000 crore through long-term infrastructure bonds to fund affordable housing and public infrastructure credit pipelines at competitive coupon yields.
items.author: Business Standard

scenario_macro_mixed.name: Scenario C: Mixed Macro Shift - Infrastructure Capex & Telecom Overhang
scenario_macro_mixed.description: L&T wins bullet train contracts and Reliance commissions clean energy gigafactory, while Bharti Airtel receives unexpected AGR tax demand notices.

items.title: Larsen & Toubro Wins Major Rs 7,500 Crore High-Speed Rail Infrastructure Contract
items.text: L&T Heavy Civil Infrastructure business has secured a mega EPC contract from the National High Speed Rail Corporation for constructing viaducts and stations. This win expands L&T's consolidated order book beyond Rs 4.5 lakh crore.
items.author: ET Infrastructure

items.title: Reliance Industries Announces Mega 20 GW Solar Gigafactory Commissioning in Gujarat
items.text: Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) chairman announced the early commissioning of its fully integrated 20 GW solar photovoltaic giga-complex in Jamnagar. Brokerages including Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs upgraded target prices, citing high future cash flow visibility in new energy.
items.author: Bloomberg Markets

items.title: Bharti Airtel Faces Stiff Department of Telecom Notice on Adjusted Gross Revenue Dues
items.text: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) has issued a fresh demand notice regarding recalculation of AGR dues totaling approximately Rs 3,400 crore against telecom operators including Bharti Airtel. Legal teams are preparing an immediate curative petition before the Supreme Court.
items.author: CNBC-TV18
